verdict.rationale: Teams' own platform docs list developer surfaces for in-chat interaction: message extensions, suggested actions (button-like replies), agent slash commands, prompt starters and message streaming, plus tab apps for custom UI. The evidence never names card-based structured message layouts or modal dialogs, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented modal/dialog support, structured rich message layouts (e.g., card schemas with interactive buttons), in-depth docs beyond feature-list titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
